kinds.d: A thick removable layer laid on a mattress to change its feel.
A thick feather- or down-filled pad laid on top of the mattress to sleep on.
A thin quilted or padded layer fitted over the mattress for light extra comfort.
A thin, often waterproof cover fitted over or around a mattress to guard it against spills and wear.
A zipped, often waterproof or anti-allergy cover fitted under the pillowcase to guard a bed pillow.

notes: Five old kinds kept, one per layer, with old sources. Bedgear's three protector SKUs (Air-X, Dri-Tec, Ver-Tex) trimmed to one brand-level range entry per the plan. Pillow protector sits with the protectors.
